track.title: Afshari
track.notes: A different performance from the Afshari of 'Ahmad Ebadi, Setar Solo' (2000), whose Afshari could not be downloaded.

just_intervals.note: measured octave minus 1200 ¢, register to register

progression.narrative: The performance opens on G4 and dwells most on G in Phrase 1. Phrase 2 (0:07.8) introduces F, centred on G. Phrase 3 (0:17.0) introduces F, centred on G. Phrase 5 (0:30.5) introduces Ek, centred on G. Phrase 10 (1:33.9) introduces A, Bk, C, centred on C. Phrase 14 (2:09.3) introduces D, centred on D. Phrase 16 (2:26.7) introduces As, centred on G. The line peaks at C5 (506.1 Hz) at 3:05.1. It closes on the tonic (G4 → C5 → G4 → G3 → D3 → G4).

theory_fit.name: Vaziri 24-tone equal temperament
theory_fit.description: Quarter-tone grid (koron/sori = exactly 50 ¢ from the natural note).

theory_fit.name: Pythagorean / Safi al-Din
theory_fit.description: Nearest note of the 17-note gamut generated by pure fifths (±8) from the tonic.
